name: Network Security
summary: Scanning, enumeration, traffic capture and analysis for network assessments
description: A toolkit for assessing networks you are authorized to test: port and service scanning, host discovery, SMB/SNMP/DNS enumeration, packet capture and analysis, traffic generation and bandwidth monitoring. Pairs well with the Sniffing and Spoofing tools and underpins both the Red Team and Blue Team profiles.
